## ✅ Pre-Review Pull Request Checklist

Before requesting a review, please confirm every item below (see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/iPablo26/Third-Semester-Baraka-2026---Data-Science/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for full details):

- [ ] **Isolated Folder:** All of my notebooks, `README.md`, and exported charts are inside `submissions/<first-last>/` using clean `snake_case` filenames (no spaces or `(1)` suffixes).
- [ ] **Zero Root File Edits:** I have **not** modified the root `requirements.txt`, root `README.md`, `.gitignore`, or shared root datasets/notebooks.
- [ ] **Portable Relative Paths:** Datasets are loaded via relative paths (e.g., `../../us_education_system_dataset.csv`) — no hardcoded `C:\Users\...` or `/Users/...` paths.
- [ ] **Clean Execution:** I ran **Restart Kernel and Run All Cells** from top to bottom with sequential execution counts (`[1], [2], ...`), zero runtime errors, and no blank scratch cells.
- [ ] **Verified Visuals & Links:** I checked the **Files changed** tab on GitHub and confirmed all embedded images in my `README.md` are committed and render without broken links.
